content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to switch inputs in [product_name] when in Online Test mode? I'm wondering if a changed input value gets sent to the connected [product_name]. Essentially, can you simulate specific input scenarios this way?

Hello, I believe you can't do that unless you truly simulate the inputs on the [product_name] itself. You can preview input simulation offline on your computer by using the F3 key. Hope this clarifies things.

Hello [user_name], just to clarify: you can test your program offline at your computer without the [product_name] device, using simulation mode, as previously mentioned. Alternatively, you may connect the [product_name] to your computer and use 'Online Test' mode to monitor program execution under real conditions with actual inputs—this helps observe the influence of real operating cycles, which differ from software simulation. If you want to simulate inputs (mainly switches and momentary-contact switches) rather than relying on real hardware, you can add parallel software switches to your input circuit. Route these through an OR logic function so that the output can be used instead of the original input signal. Assign names to these software switches in the parameter menu. You can create text boxes showing the states and names of up to ten such switches. Note that these simulated signals can be changed only on the [product_name] device itself, not remotely from the PC, for alternative operation or simulation. You can adjust the states via text boxes or through the device's menu. Hope this information helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are trying to simulate input scenarios using 'Online Test' mode in [product_name]. The discussion confirms that direct input simulation from the PC in Online Test mode is not possible; simulation must be performed offline in the software or by manually altering inputs on the device itself. Alternative solutions include designing circuits with software switches to partially simulate certain scenarios, but such approaches come with practical limitations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to toggle or simulate input signals from their PC during Online Test mode, allowing them to see changes reflected on their connected [product_name] device for comprehensive live scenario evaluation.
